scope: D-001 through D-011 requested geometry inputs; recommendations only; no records, statuses or events changed
evidence_policy: Existing original drawing images visually inspected. Existing generated records and ai_results read for context, not treated as original proof. Existing source fact IDs preserved; no parsed numeric IDs invented. Boxes use existing PDF-page coordinate metadata when present; null means whole-page source.
mvp: rectangle/circle/ring planar constant-thickness solid, supported holes/slots; no rounded outer contours, bends, stepped/revolved bodies or replacement bounding boxes
